reepham-cross-country|2027-01-31.summary: One- and two-lap cross-country races from Whitwell Station near Reepham. Juniors start 10:00; both senior distances start together at 10:15.

5K.note: Senior one lap (approximately 5K) starts 10:15; juniors start 10:00. Organiser Leona confirmed juniors 10:00 and seniors 10:15 in her 31 October 2026 13:51 UTC reply. Fresh review of the authorised Total Race Timing page on 31 October shows both Seniors (1 lap) and Seniors (2 laps) at 10:15, agreeing with its programme. This supersedes the 21 October owner clarification; no separate 10:30 senior wave remains advertised.
5K.publicNote: Seniors: one lap (approximately 5K), 10:15. Both senior distances start together. Juniors (one lap) start 10:00. All times local (Europe/London).
